roomTypeId.description: Inventory type determined by bed count and window availability.

hasWindow.description: Whether the room has a window.

defaultNightlyRate.description: Nightly rate; may be null until configured

canCreateStay.description: Whether an immediate stay can be created for this room on the requested business date.

canCreateAdvance.description: Whether an advance reservation can be created for this room on the requested business date.

unavailableReason.description: Backend-provided reason when the room cannot be used for a new stay.

isRequestedRoomAvailable.description: Whether the receptionist can keep the requested room for the requested interval.

availableRoomCount.description: Remaining sellable rooms in the type for the requested period.

canReserveRoomType.description: Whether an advance reservation may be confirmed against type inventory and assigned later.

alternatives.description: Available rooms with exactly the same bed count and window attribute.

hasWindow.description: Whether the room has a window. Only equivalent rooms with the same value can be suggested.

defaultNightlyRate.description: Nightly rate; omit to keep it unset

rate.description: Set to null in persistence to clear the rate

roomId.description: Physical room assigned to the stay. It can be null for a room-type advance reservation.

preferredRoomId.description: Requested room preference used when the reservation is assigned.

assignmentMode.description: Exact assigns the selected physical room. Room-type mode keeps it as a preference and assigns a matching room at check-in.

plannedCheckOutAt.description: Omit or send null when the planned checkout is not yet known.

roomRatePerNight.description: Nightly room rate in integer VND. Stored as an immutable reservation snapshot.

depositAmount.description: Actual deposit in integer VND. Allowed only for an advance reservation and recorded as a completed payment.

isOpenEnded.description: Whether this stay has no planned checkout and is billed live.

chargedNights.description: Number of room nights currently charged by the Backend.

amountAsOf.description: Instant used by the Backend to calculate live open-stay pricing.

unitPrice.description: Required for a manually entered service. Integer VND only.
